annotation_classes.Grade 1: Superficial ulcer (full skin thickness, no subcutaneous involvement)
annotation_classes.Grade 2: Deep ulcer (penetrating to tendon, ligament, or capsule, without bone involvement)
annotation_classes.Grade 3: Deep ulcer with abscess, osteomyelitis, or joint sepsis

medical_annotation_claims.clinical_verification_note: Annotations categorize DFU into 4 Wagner grades. Specific clinician IDs and inter-rater agreement metrics are not provided in export metadata.
